newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes one full cent stronger.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes one full cent stronger.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar rallied more than a full Canadian cent to end at C$1.3413 (US$0.7456) on Wednesday from Tuesday's close at C$1.3519 (US$0.7397) in moderate trade, dealers said. * They said most of the trading took place overnight and during the morning, with interest coming from Europe on bullish reports about Canada.
Most of the interest came from European rather than domestic buyers, dealers said. They said some U.S. institutions also issued buy recommendations on Wednesday.
The rally prompted the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England to intervene to sell Canadian dollars around C$1.3440 (US$0.7441) to slow the pace of the rally.

The currency broke through key technical support points on Wednesday, prompting traders to expect more strength on Thursday. On the crosses, the currency rose to 1.1815 marks from Tuesday's 1.1777 marks and strengthened to 86.96 yen from 86.38 yen.
